X-Series: Cortech Endurance X-Series Laminate Table with X-Base
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-endurance-x-series-laminate-table-w-xbase
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/x-base-tables/endurance-x-series-laminate-tables/
Spec sheets: X-Base Laminate Tables, Assembly
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance X-Series Laminate Table with X-Base
Current H1: Cortech Endurance X‑Series Laminate Table with X‑Base
Subtitle: Square or Round Laminate Table on a Molded X-Base with Plain or Game Top for Dayrooms
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Endurance Table with X-Base and Laminate Top - 36SDPX, 36SVPX, 36SDGX, 36SVGX, 42RDPX, 42RVPX, 42SDPX, 42SVPX, 42SDGX, 42SVGX, 48RDPX, 48RVPX, 48RDGX, 48RVGX
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance X-Series Laminate Table with X-Base pairs a laminate top with the rotationally molded Endurance X-base, for dayrooms and dining areas in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The x-shaped base carries heavy loads without tipping and helps keep chairs and people apart.
The seamless laminate top resists impact and has a rounded bull nose Dura-Edge for safety and comfort. The legs fasten to the top with tamper-resistant screws and a metal-to-metal connection, and the table can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes or weighed down by filling the legs with sand. Tops come in 36” and 42” square and 42” and 48” round, with a plain top or a game top.
Top: Seamless laminate top with high impact resistance and a rounded bull nose Dura-Edge
Base: Rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene X-base
Connection: The legs fasten to the top with tamper-resistant screws and a metal-to-metal connection
Top Sizes: 36”×36” or 42”×42” square, or 42” or 48” round
Game Top: Optional on the 36” and 42” square and the 48” round tables
Edge Colors: Dura-Edge in Atlantis, Black, Burgundy, Concrete, Dove Grey, Gray, Hunter Green, or Sienna
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Custom Tops: Other laminate finishes available; contact Cortech for details
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the base; 5-year warranty on the laminate top
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
36SDPX / 36SDGX – 36”×36” Square: Plain or game top, Dura-Edge
42SDPX / 42SDGX – 42”×42” Square: Plain or game top, Dura-Edge
42RDPX – 42” Round: Plain top, Dura-Edge
48RDPX / 48RDGX – 48” Round: Plain or game top, Dura-Edge
Vinyl Edge Models: 36SVPX, 36SVGX, 42SVPX, 42SVGX, 42RVPX, 48RVPX, and 48RVGX
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Sabre Mount System
Ballast: The legs can be filled with sand to weigh the table down
Assembly: The two leg pieces slide together and attach to the top with tamper-resistant screws (T40 bit); see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The X-Series Laminate Table suits dayrooms and dining areas that want the look of a laminate top on a heavy, stable molded base.
Typical applications include:
Dining rooms and dayrooms in correctional facilities and jails
Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and activity rooms
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (53 characters): Cortech Endurance X-Series Laminate Table with X-Base
Meta description (149 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance X-Series laminate table with molded X-base. Square or round laminate tops with plain or game top, for dayrooms and dining.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I kept your current H1. There are 14 models, so I did not add model numbers to the H1; they are listed under Available Models and Options. Your current H1 uses non-breaking hyphens in "X‑Series" and "X‑Base." I used normal hyphens.
Meta title: adding "at Anchortex" would make it more than 65 characters, so I left it off.
Vinyl edge: 7 of your 14 variants are vinyl edge models. The current Cortech spec sheet says all tops come with Dura-Edge as standard and lists only the 7 Dura-Edge models. The January 2025 Cortech catalog still offers Dura-Edge or vinyl edge. I listed the vinyl edge models on their own line. Would you like to keep them, or remove those variants?
Leg bottoms: your current page says to "specify leg bottom: _G Floor Glide or _B Bolt Down." The Cortech spec sheet model numbers have no G or B, and the X-base is bolted down or filled with sand, so I left this out.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime on the base and 5 years on the laminate top, so I used that.
Colors: your current page says the X-base is black, plain tops are gray, and game tops are white. The Cortech spec sheet lists the base in 18 colors and the Dura-Edge in 8 colors, and refers to the Cortech color guide for laminate tops. I used the spec sheet.
I left out "Stain resistant," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say it.
Weight and height: Cortech does not publish weights or heights for the laminate tables. Your variants are set to 65 lbs (square), 60 lbs (42” round), and 86 lbs (48” round), the same as your molded X-base table pages. I left them as they are. Would you like me to change them?
Outdoor use: the Cortech FAQ says laminate tables are not recommended for outdoor use, so this page does not mention outdoor use.
Product images: the page has four images. The last two are the same laminate color chart uploaded twice. Would you like me to remove the duplicate?
